verdict.rationale: Railway documents its own horizontal scaling: you can add replicas behind load balancing and run services closer to users. Nothing shows sub-second instance boot, and nothing shows automatic scaling under load to tens of thousands of instances, so only a thin slice of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: any evidence of sub-second cold start or boot time, load-triggered autoscaling, documented scale limits reaching tens of thousands of instances, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can deploy instances that boot in under a second and scale to tens of thousands under load

citations.quote: Scale CPU and RAM or add replicas with load balancing.
Run your application closer to where your users are.
